$RWUSD: Evaluating Relative Volume Against Diverse Peers

The primary asset $RWUSD currently shows an hourly direction of up with volume levels sitting above its baseline. While price moves within a recorded range, the presence of heightened activity invites a deeper look at market context. This research explores how localized momentum behaves when compared to broader venue activity. We observe $ETH moving downward on volume that stays below its baseline, while $INIT matches the upward hourly direction of our primary asset on elevated volume.

A key mechanism to consider is liquidity absorption. When volume exceeds the baseline during an upward move, it indicates that sellers are active but buyers are currently overcoming that supply. This differs from a move on low volume, where prices can shift without significant conviction. However, seeing $RWUSD and $INIT both move upward hourly does not imply a shared cause or a measured correlation. These movements are separate events on the same venue.

The difference between a brief spike and a trend depends on how the move holds against resistance levels like 0.9999. If the RSI reaches 51.0365 while the MACD signal sits at -1.96567e-05, traders often look for whether the pace of volume sustains. A concrete way to reassess this is to monitor if volume drops while the price remains near 0.999673. If volume fades but price holds, it suggests a lack of aggressive selling rather than continued buying pressure.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What does the candle you FOMO into usually look like?
translatedData.subTitle:
When a coin’s price shoots up in a huge bullish candle, everyone in the group is yelling “Go!” You get nervous and chase in—and then end up
buying at the top. This scenario plays out every day.

Take a good look at that huge bullish candle that makes your heart race: it’s the one people who are already fully invested want you to chase so you can take
That’s what happens. Chasing after a sudden surge in volume is essentially providing liquidity for those who were already holding.

A simple but effective rule: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candles. If the pullback comes on lower volume and stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if it drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself an expensive lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you your original capital back.

translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a trade look at? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Notice that this thought is all attachment and no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to current supply and demand.

Once you’re stuck holding a losing trade, you automatically collect bullish signals and filter out bearish ones. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple in theory, but hard to do: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
will no longer hold,” then act when that point comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decision-making from holding the position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

Ethereum’s two major clients rush out patches: certificate flaw could have let attackers divert validator rewards

- According to reports from CoinDesk and ChainCatcher on October 29, Ethereum clients Teku (26.10.3, released Tuesday) and Besu (26.10.2, released Monday) issued emergency updates, revoking trust in certificates associated with India-based certificate authority eMudhra.
- The issue stems from researchers’ discovery on October 17 that the private keys of eight intermediate certificate authorities operated by eMudhra could be derived from public certificates due to insufficient randomness. Attackers could use this to forge certificates and impersonate external services that validators connect to. Under certain configurations—especially when using an external signer—this could potentially redirect block rewards to an attacker-controlled address.
- The good news: the Teku team says mainnet nodes using the default configuration are unaffected, and no real-world exploitation has been found so far. eMudhra revoked the affected certificates on October 18 and announced it was exiting the certificate business. The risk is that Java does not check revocation status by default, and Docker images previously continued to trust these certificates.
- Node operators, take note: Docker users can simply update their images; users running binaries directly also need to manually update Java and their trusted certificate lists. Those still using Java 26, which is no longer receiving updates, should migrate to Java 25.

My take: short-term outlook for $ETH  is neutral, as the vulnerability has been patched and there is no evidence of actual exploitation. But it reminds the market that even “small” infrastructure-layer vulnerabilities can affect validator earnings, so near-term sentiment should be cautious.

Sources: CoinDesk, ChainCatcher (as cited by Foresight News), and a statement from the Teku team. BTC is around $80,200, and ETH around $2,310. Tonight’s 20:30 PCE/GDP data is the next potential catalyst.

以太坊两大客户端紧急打补丁：证书漏洞本可让攻击者截走验证者奖励

- 据 CoinDesk、ChainCatcher 10 月 29 日报道，以太坊客户端 Teku（26.10.3，周二发布）与 Besu（26.10.2，周一发布）紧急更新，撤销对印度证书机构 eMudhra 相关证书的信任。
- 根源是 10 月 17 日研究人员发现：eMudhra 旗下 8 个中级证书机构的私钥因随机数不足，可以从公开证书中被推算出来。攻击者借此伪造证书、冒充验证者连接的外部服务，在特定配置（尤其使用外置签名器）下，可能把区块奖励引向攻击者地址。
- 好消息是：Teku 团队称默认配置的主网节点不受影响，目前也未发现实际利用；eMudhra 已于 10 月 18 日吊销相关证书并宣布退出证书业务。风险点在于 Java 默认不校验吊销状态，此前 Docker 镜像仍信任这些证书。
- 节点运营商注意：Docker 用户更新镜像即可；直接跑二进制的用户还需手动更新 Java 及受信证书列表，仍在用已停更 Java 26 的要迁移到 Java 25。

我的判断：对 $ETH 短期偏中性，因为漏洞已打补丁且未见实际利用，但它提醒市场：基础设施层的“小”漏洞同样能触动验证者收益，短线情绪上偏谨慎。

来源：CoinDesk、ChainCatcher（Foresight News 转引）、Teku 团队说明。BTC 约 8.02 万美元，ETH 约 2310 美元，今晚 20:30 PCE/GDP 数据为下一触发点。

translatedData.content:
Could the recovery phrase on a hardware wallet bought at a brick-and-mortar store have been “listened to” before you even unbox it? Singapore police have issued a public warning about exactly this.

On October 28, the Singapore Police Force (SPF) issued a notice: since September 10, 2026, at least two cases have involved tampered Ledger hardware wallets, with combined losses of around US$3.5 million. Preliminary investigations indicate that some devices bought at retail stores in Singapore had malicious hardware components hidden inside. These could capture recovery phrases or private keys as users entered them, allowing the attackers to transfer the victims’ crypto without their knowledge.

Here are a few points that really matter for ordinary users👇

🔹 This is not a case of “remote hackers breaking into Ledger’s chip.” Both the authorities’ and Ledger’s previous statements point to the distribution stage: genuine devices were opened after leaving the factory, tampered with, and then put back into retail channels. A breach of the chip or the system itself is not the main narrative at this point.
🔹 The SPF has contacted Ledger, and the company is reviewing the devices involved. The police investigation is ongoing. Earlier, Ledger had already asked authorized distributors in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and tightened rules, including a ban on putting returned devices back on sale.
🔹 The police have given cryptocurrency holders specific advice: don’t enter your recovery phrase into a suspicious device or continue using it to make transfers. If you suspect your recovery phrase has been exposed, use a new device you know is safe to generate a new recovery phrase, then move your remaining assets to it. Anyone claiming to be “official customer support / the police / an exchange” and asking for your recovery phrase is a scammer.
🔹 The loss figure is based on the two reported cases; it does not represent the total across the market. Blockchain analytics firms estimate higher losses from the broader implant attack across Southeast Asia, but that’s a different set of figures—don’t equate it directly with the SPF’s US$3.5 million.

Put simply: cold wallets protect against online database breaches, but they can’t protect you from “where you bought it.” Buy from the official website or an authorized channel, check the packaging when you open it, and generate your recovery phrase yourself—these matter more than worrying over which model to choose.

Did you buy your hardware wallet directly from the official website, or through an airport, electronics store, or purchasing agent? Share in the comments👇

#新加坡警方警示Ledger硬件钱包被篡改 #BTC #ETH

content:
实体店买回来的硬件钱包，助记词有没有可能在开箱前就被人「听」走？新加坡警方把这件事写成了公开警示。

10 月 28 日，新加坡警察部队（SPF）发布通报：自 2026 年 9 月 10 日以来，至少两起案件涉及被篡改的 Ledger 硬件钱包，损失合计约 350 万美元。初步调查显示，部分在新加坡零售店买到的设备，内部被塞进了恶意硬件组件，能在用户录入时截获助记词或私钥，进而在当事人不知情的情况下把币转走。

几个对普通人真正要紧的点👇

🔹 这不是「远程黑客攻破 Ledger 芯片」——官方与 Ledger 此前口径都指向分销环节：正品离开厂家后，被人拆开植入、再回流到零售渠道。芯片、系统本身被攻破，目前不是主叙事
🔹 SPF 已与 Ledger 联系，公司在复核涉案设备；警方调查仍在进行。更早些时候，Ledger 已要求东南亚及香港授权经销商暂停销售，并收紧退货机不得二次上架等规则
🔹 警方给持币人的操作建议很具体：别再往可疑设备里输助记词、别继续用它转账；怀疑助记词已泄露的，用一台确认干净的新设备，重新生成助记词，把剩余资产迁过去；任何自称「官方客服 / 警察 / 交易所」索要助记词的，一律当骗子
🔹 损失数字来自已报案的两起案件口径，不等于全市场总量；链上分析机构对东南亚整起植入攻击的估算更高，但那是另一套统计，别和 SPF 这 350 万直接划等号

说白了：冷钱包防的是线上拖库，防不住「你从哪儿买的」。官网或官方授权渠道、开箱验包装、助记词只在自己手里生成——这几条比纠结哪一款型号更要紧。

你的硬件钱包是官网直购，还是机场、数码店、代购渠道？评论区聊聊👇

title: 10月29日 晚间盘 10币全景：欧盘七币翻红但12小时全线收阴，缩量到七日均量四成，BTC 在8万与布林下轨间夹缝
subTitle:
【一句话定调】

欧盘给了四个小时的修复，但没给量。

十币 4 小时维度七涨三跌（TON -0.99%、BNB -0.34%、XRP -0.12% 走低），看着像止跌；把窗口拉到 12 小时，十币全部收阴，最弱的 ADA 与 AVAX 各跌 3.01% 和 3.04%；再看 24 小时，九跌一涨。成交量上，除 BNB 的 1.23 倍，其余九币全部低于 7 日均量，BTC 与 ETH 只剩四成，TON 只有 5%。空头没在加速，多头也没进场，这是缩量僵持。（数据快照：北京时间 18:00）

【大盘：$BTC】

80204，24h -1.63%，4h +0.29%，12h -1.32%。

日内区间 79710–81789，上下只有 2.6%，是近几日最窄的一天。现价上方第一道 MA7 80691，第二道 MA25 82211，距 MA25 还有 -2.44%；下方布林下轨 79588 只隔 616 美元，再往下是 30 日低 79221。

RSI 42.9，中性偏弱；MACD 柱 -236.8，仍在零轴下方且未见明显收敛。布林位置 13.8%，30 日分位 12.3%，ATR 2.24%——波动率是十币里最低的。低波动叠加低量能，通常意味着方向要等外部变量来定，而不是自己走出来。

多空条件很清楚：4 小时收盘站上 80691 且量能回到 7 日均量以上，欧盘这波修复才算有效；失守 79710，布林下轨 79588 会被二次测试，破了就是 79221。

【二线梯队：$ETH SOL XRP】

以太 2321，24h -2.18%，4h +0.34%。午盘时价格还贴着 MA99 2339.8，现在已明确落到其下方 19 美元，是本轮第一次连续两段确认失守长期均线。布林位置 12.4%，30 日分位 7.9%，30 日低 2282 距现价 -1.7%。RSI 35.4，比 BTC 低 7 个点，弱势已经分层。

SOL 100.32，-2.60%，4h +0.23%。100 整数位勉强守住，但布林下轨 98.83 与 30 日低 98.62 几乎重叠，构成一条只有 0.2 美元的窄支撑带。跌破它，下方没有结构。量能 47%，反弹没有资金配合。

XRP 1.2926，-2.91%，4h -0.12%，是二线里欧盘唯一还在走低的。MA99 1.3023 已由支撑转为压力，价格在其下方 0.7%。唯一的多头线索是 MACD 柱 +0.0015 仍为正——动能在衰减，但价格没跟上，属于典型的钝化不反弹。布林位置 23.6%，在这组里偏高。

【平台与支付：$BNB TON】

BNB 749.7，-0.50%，4h -0.34%。它从午盘的 758 回落到 750 下方，但三个"唯一"还在：唯一 MA7（745.09）位于 MA25（743.44）之上，唯一 MACD 柱为正（+2.37），唯一成交量超过 7 日均量（1.23 倍）。布林位置从 92.7% 退到 76.1%，从贴轨回到通道内——强势没破，短线弹性却已释放完毕。24h 高 762.2 是近几日天花板，30 日高 809.99 还在 -7.45% 之外。

TON 1.60，+0.95%，是十币里唯一 24h 收涨的。但这个涨幅不可信：成交量只有 7 日均量的 5%，基本等于没有交易。价格站上 MA7 1.5814，却仍在 MA25 1.646 与 MA99 1.631 之下，反弹连第一道中期均线都没碰到。4h -0.99% 说明欧盘它反而是回落的。

【高弹性尾部：DOGE ADA AVAX LINK】

DOGE 0.0783，-2.81%，4h +0.29%。MA7 0.0783 与现价完全重合，等于没有方向。量能 31%，十币里倒数第二。布林位置 27.5%，在这个尾部组里最高，但量能不起，位置本身没有意义。

ADA 0.1999，-3.85%，是今天最弱的一个。24h 低 0.1956 与 30 日低完全重合——今日创下 30 日新低，30 日分位 5.0%，距 30 日高 0.2824 有 -29.21%。RSI 33.4 接近超卖，ATR 5.23% 意味着日内仍有 5% 的摆动空间。它 4h +0.91% 是十币中最强的反弹，但幅度不到跌幅的三分之一。

AVAX 8.74，-3.44%。24h 低 8.559 同样等于 30 日低，也是日内新低。MA25 9.855 在上方 -11.35%，距离太远，短期不构成参考；现价仍在 MA99 8.349 上方 4.6%，这是它唯一的相对优势。

LINK 11.51，-3.06%，4h +0.66%。24h 低 11.289 距 30 日低 11.2 只差 0.8%，算是守住了。MA99 11.314 就在脚下 1.7%，是这组里唯一还站在长期均线上方的币。RSI 39.4，量能 50%，属于弱但没有破位。

【盘面主线】

三条线。

第一，量能是核心矛盾。十币里九个低于 7 日均量，BTC 与 ETH 双双只剩四成，ADA 的 88% 已是尾部组最高。缩量下跌的性质是抛压衰竭，不等于买盘回归，把它直接当底部信号容易过早。

“More than $25 billion in annualized settlement volume”—sounds like that much was settled over a whole year, but it’s actually a run-rate figure.

Visa CEO Ryan McInerney said on the company’s Q4 fiscal-year earnings call on October 27 (U.S. Eastern Time) that the annualized run rate for stablecoin settlements had surpassed $25 billion, up about 10x year over year. Here are a few points that really matter to everyday users 👇

🔹 $25 billion is a run rate extrapolated over a full year at the current pace, not the cumulative settlement total for fiscal 2026. In September, the company had reported an annualized pace of more than $20 billion; this time, it raised that figure another notch.

🔹 Settlement support has expanded to 10 blockchains (more than double last year), spanning all five of Visa’s regions. Supported stablecoins include USDC, USDG, EURC, PayPal USD (PYUSD), and SBC, issued by Brale, among others.

🔹 Another track is cards you can actually use to pay: there are more than 225 Visa card programs linked to stablecoins, up over 70% year over year; around 5 million cards across more than 50 countries; and related spending volume is up over 150% year over year. Issuers include exchanges, neobanks, wallets, and remittance providers—stablecoins may be held in an account, but payments at merchants often still run over Visa.

🔹 This is not the same thing as “settlement volume”: settlement is when network participants use stablecoins to settle with Visa; card programs are about cardholders spending their stablecoin balances. The company hasn’t combined the two into one grand total, so don’t interpret $25 billion as “total global stablecoin card spending.”

Put simply: stablecoins are being plugged into everyday clearing and card-payment channels by card networks. But $25 billion is still small compared with Visa’s overall payment volume, so don’t let the words “10x” lead you to think stablecoins are about to replace bank cards. If you want to spend using stablecoins, first check whether your card or wallet is part of one of those 225-plus programs, and look at the conversion rate and fees.

Do you know anyone with a Visa card that can be used to spend stablecoins directly? Tell us in the comments 👇

#Visa稳定币年化结算量超250亿美元 #BTC #ETH

content:
「年化结算量超 250 亿美元」——听着像一整年结了这么多，其实是运行率口径。

Visa CEO 瑞安·麦金纳尼在 10 月 27 日（美东）财年四季度电话会上说：稳定币结算的年化运行率已超过 250 亿美元，同比大约涨了 10 倍。几个对普通人真正要紧的点👇

🔹 250 亿是「按现在速度外推全年」的 run rate，不是 2026 财年累计结算额；9 月时公司还报过超过 200 亿美元的年化节奏，这次再往上抬了一档

🔹 结算支持已扩到 10 条区块链（比去年翻倍以上），覆盖 Visa 全部五大区域；可结算的稳定币包括 USDC、USDG、EURC、PayPal USD（PYUSD）以及 Brale 发行的 SBC 等

🔹 另一条线是「能刷卡」：稳定币关联的 Visa 卡项目超过 225 个，同比增超 70%；约 500 万张卡、50 多个国家，相关刷卡量同比增超 150%。发卡方里有交易所、新银行、钱包和汇款机构——账上稳定币，走到商户端往往还是刷 Visa

🔹 和「结算量」不是一回事：结算是网络参与方用稳定币和 Visa 清算；卡项目是持卡人把稳定币余额花出去。公司没把两条线并成一个总金额，别把 250 亿理解成「全球稳定币刷卡总额」

说白了：稳定币正在被卡组织接进日常清算和刷卡通道，但 250 亿相对 Visa 整体支付体量仍然很小，别被「10 倍」三个字带偏成马上替代银行卡。真要用稳定币消费的，先看你用的那张卡/钱包是否在这 225 个项目里、以及兑出汇率和手续费。

你身边有能直接刷稳定币的 Visa 卡吗？评论区聊聊👇

translatedData.content:
Russia Plans to Make Risk Tests a شرط for Crypto Investing

The Central Bank of Russia has proposed a regulatory framework for the cryptocurrency market that would allow retail and professional investors to legally trade crypto assets, subject to strict risk controls. The proposal has been submitted to the government for review, with the goal of completing the necessary legislative amendments and establishing a basic legal framework by July 1, 2026. It is important to note that this is still a regulatory proposal and does not mean the framework has been formally implemented.

One key feature of the proposal is linking investor categories to risk tests. Retail investors would be allowed to invest only in highly liquid mainstream cryptocurrencies specified by law, and would first have to pass a risk test. Their annual investment limit through a single intermediary would be 300,000 rubles. Professional investors would also need to pass a risk-awareness test, but would be able to invest in a wider range of cryptocurrencies, excluding privacy coins, with no investment limit. Digital currencies and stablecoins are proposed to be classified as “monetary assets” that may be traded and invested in lawfully, but not used as a means of payment within Russia.

This approach reflects a regulatory strategy that is neither a simple opening-up nor an outright ban. Instead, it establishes tiered entry requirements based on the range of products, investor qualifications, investment limits, and intermediary responsibilities. The purpose of the test is to confirm that participants have a basic understanding of volatility, potential losses, and related risks; the investment limit, meanwhile, is intended to keep ordinary investors’ risk exposure within predefined bounds. The central bank has also explicitly warned that crypto assets are not issued or backed by any jurisdiction, and that price volatility and sanctions risks remain significant. Establishing a regulatory framework does not amount to providing investment protection.

For the crypto market, if the relevant legislation moves forward, the initial impact would be on compliance infrastructure. Exchanges, brokerages, and trust companies that already hold financial licenses may be permitted to provide related services, while custodians and exchange providers could face more independent requirements for security, asset segregation, and compliance. In addition, as trading shifts from informal channels to regulated intermediaries, tax reporting, customer identification, and transaction recordkeeping may become more important. Residents who buy crypto through overseas accounts or transfer crypto assets abroad through local intermediaries would also be subject to reporting requirements.

The editor’s view is that the significance of a standardized risk test lies not in predicting whether crypto assets will rise or fall, but in setting a verifiable entry process for retail participation. What matters next is not the proposal’s title, but how highly liquid assets are specifically defined, what standards the tests will use, how investment limits will be enforced, and whether the legislative timeline stays on track. From July 1, 2027, institutions that conduct exchange, custody, or intermediary business without authorization are proposed to face legal liability. This also means that compliance boundaries will be a factor market participants need to assess on an ongoing basis.

content:
俄罗斯拟将风险测试纳入加密投资准入

俄罗斯央行提出加密货币市场监管方案，计划在严格风险控制的前提下，允许散户和专业投资人依法参与加密资产交易。该方案已提交政府审议，目标是在2026年7月1日前完成必要的立法修订与基础法律框架制定。需要注意的是，这仍是监管提案，并不代表制度已经正式落地。

提案的关键设计之一，是把投资者分类与风险测试绑定。一般散户只能投资法律规定的高流动性主流加密货币，且须先通过风险测试；其经由单一中介机构的年度投资额度上限为30万卢布。专业投资人同样需要通过风险认知测试，但可投资范围扩大至匿名币以外的加密货币，金额不设上限。数字货币和稳定币拟被界定为“货币资产”，可依法交易和投资，但不得作为俄罗斯境内支付工具。

这一安排反映出监管思路并非简单放开或禁止，而是以产品范围、投资者资质、额度和中介责任构建分层门槛。测试的作用在于确认参与者对波动、损失承担及相关风险具备基本认知；额度限制则试图将普通投资者的风险暴露控制在预设范围内。央行也明确提示，加密资产不由任何司法辖区发行或担保，价格波动和制裁风险仍不可忽视，建立监管制度不等于提供投资保障。

对加密市场而言，若相关立法推进，影响路径首先将落在合规基础设施。持有既有金融牌照的交易所、券商和信托机构，拟可提供相关服务；托管和兑换机构则可能面对更独立的安全、资产隔离与合规要求。其次，交易活动从非正式渠道转向受监管中介，可能提升税务申报、客户识别和资金流记录的重要性。居民使用海外账户买入或通过本地中介向海外转移加密资产，也将被纳入申报要求。

编辑观察认为，统一风险测试的意义不在于判断加密资产本身的涨跌，而在于为零售参与设定可验证的准入程序。后续值得关注的不是提案标题，而是高流动性资产的具体认定、测试标准、额度如何执行，以及立法时间表是否如期推进。到2027年7月1日起，未获许可开展兑换、托管或中介业务的机构拟面临法律责任，这也意味着合规边界将成为市场参与者需要持续评估的变量。

translatedData.content:
Let's talk about the EIP-1559 fee mechanism.
Before EIP-1559, Ethereum used a first-price auction: users set their own Gas prices, and all bids went to miners.
One thing many people overlook: the more congested the chain, the more the base fee rises, and the more ETH is burned. Comparing the amount burned with the amount newly issued determines whether the ETH supply increases or decreases during that period.
The maximum fee shown in a wallet is just a cap; the actual amount spent is based on the on-chain record in the block explorer.
According to EIP-1559, the base fee paid for every Ethereum transaction is $ETH , and it is burned directly.

很多人忽略的一点：链上越拥堵，基础费涨得越多，销毁的 ETH 也越多；烧掉的量和新发行量对比，决定了那段时间 ETH 供应是增是减。
钱包显示的最高费用只是上限，实际花了多少以区块浏览器里的链上记录为准。

Crypto analyst Tom Lee posted on social media platform X, agreeing with Rick Rieder’s view: The Fed’s continued rate hikes cannot resolve the oil supply shock and may instead worsen the housing supply shortage. Lee pointed out that high interest rates can boost investment returns and stimulate more demand. This means expectations of Fed rate hikes may intensify, further fueling inflation. Lee’s views were reported by Odaily.

Why does this news matter?
As a well-known crypto analyst, Tom Lee’s views often attract market attention. He believes rate hikes cannot solve the underlying problem and may instead stimulate demand, which differs somewhat from traditional economic thinking. The key point is that Lee directly links this to the housing shortage and inflation, suggesting that in a high-interest-rate environment, demand for hard assets such as real estate may increase, while crypto markets could become an alternative destination for investors seeking higher returns.

Market impact
In the short term, this view could prompt the market to reassess the effectiveness of Fed policy. In terms of how it might play out, if the Fed continues to raise rates amid persistent inflationary pressure, investors may turn to tangible assets such as real estate in a high-interest-rate environment, while crypto markets could benefit from some inflows as an alternative investment. However, Lee’s warning also suggests that these inflows may not address the root causes of the core economic problems. In the longer term, if inflation remains high, crypto markets could also face risks. Historically, following the dot-com bubble’s burst in 2000, market perceptions of the relationship between interest rates and asset prices continued to evolve.

Trading perspective
Lee’s assessment suggests that, in the current market environment, expectations of Fed rate hikes may still support short-term sentiment in crypto markets, but investors should be wary of the inflationary consequences that could result from this demand stimulus. Crypto markets may benefit from some inflows of safe-haven capital, but in the long term, investors should continue to monitor the core economic cycle.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t an Admission of Failure—it’s the Price of Admission to Your Next Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to set a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong.” Their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the small loss is the premium.
The difference between a pro and a gambler isn’t who’s more often right, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest trader I’ve ever seen cuts his losses more decisively than anyone. Because he knows: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you set a stop-loss, tell yourself
this is the price of admission, not a verdict.

content:
Three ways to sell $ETH without watching it, and each acts differently when price spikes and comes right back.

Spot, ETHUSDT, order type dropdown, OCO or Trailing Stop, no API key, just the spot fee. With $ETH near 2,320 USDT, a fading spike plays out so: an OCO (limit above, stop below, one fills, the other cancels) sells at the target if the spike gets there, else you hold, floor intact; a trailing stop follows the spike up by your delta and sells on the way back; a ladder of limit sells, say 20% every 3% up, fills a rung and keeps the rest. 🪜 OCO for a target-and-floor trader, trailing for a trend rider, ladder for whoever distrusts one number.

1. OCO stop leg as Stop Limit with the limit a hair under the trigger, so a fast candle blows through it and nothing sells; pick Stop Market for that leg.
2. A 1% trailing delta on a coin that swings more than that daily, so noise kicks you out early; set it wider than a normal day's range, 5% as an example, with an activation price above current.
3. A ladder with no floor, selling one rung into the spike and riding the rest down; give the unfilled coins their own stop, and since open orders lock coins, split the quantity.

Set a sell OCO's stop leg to Market so the floor sells when hit.

The endorsement of a former Swift CEO could bring OpenTrade greater market recognition for its compliance capabilities and institutional-grade services. In the long term, this could accelerate the integration of crypto stablecoins with traditional money markets. For example, if OpenTrade can successfully bring in bank-grade clients, it could encourage more traditional financial institutions to use stablecoins for cross-border payments.

The stablecoin sector as a whole has lacked catalysts, and this personnel change could provide one. title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

Cryptocurrency Basics | What exactly is an NFT?
An NFT, or Non-Fungible Token, is a token with a unique ID that cannot be exchanged on a like-for-like basis with another token.
NFT prices are determined by buyers’ and sellers’ offers. Trading activity is often lower than for fungible tokens, so there may not be a buyer when you want to sell.

Fed holds rates, but two votes favor a hike | ETH funds see $21.4 million in net outflows | Wait for confirmation before reclaiming 2,357
My stance is to wait and see for now, and not misread “standing pat” as a loosening of liquidity. #FOMC remains a trending topic on Binance Square. In its official statement on October 28, the Federal Reserve voted 10–2 to maintain the federal funds target range at 3.75% to 4%; the two dissenting members wanted a 25-basis-point hike this time. The statement also said that economic activity was strong and inflation remained elevated. The facts are that there was no rate hike this time, and that there were indeed dissenting votes calling for one; this does not directly imply that rates will definitely be raised next time, much less mean that the Fed has already shifted toward rate cuts.

For ETH, rates remaining high mean that the opportunity cost of holding a non-yielding spot asset is still there. Whether institutional buying can offset this pressure depends on fund flows, not just the wording of the meeting statement. Farside’s updated U.S. ETH fund table for October 28 shows total net outflows of $21.4 million, including $44.8 million in net outflows from ETHA and $18.8 million in net inflows to FETH; other ETH funds recorded $3.6 million in net inflows. Inflows to a single product cannot stand in for a market-wide conclusion, and fund subscriptions and redemptions are not the same as spot trading on exchanges at any given moment. The signal is that flows remain mixed, which is not enough to support the claim that “institutions are buying back ETH across the board.”

The market has not yet provided strong confirmation either. When I checked Kraken, ETH/USD was around $2,315, below its opening price of $2,357, with an intraday low of about $2,291; BTC/USD was around $79,921, also below its opening price of $81,287. ETH has recovered somewhat from its low, but has still not reclaimed its opening level. This synchronized weakness looks more like risk appetite is under pressure; we cannot conclude, based on timing alone, that the two dissenting votes directly caused this decline. I would treat $2,357 as the first hurdle for a renewed strengthening, and the area around $2,290 as the zone to watch for the intraday low. If ETH breaks above $2,357 but quickly falls back below it, that would show the rebound lacks sustained buying. If it breaks below $2,290 and cannot recover, the short-term recovery thesis is invalidated.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and keep a conditional spot-long bias, with a maximum position size of 2% of total capital and no leverage. title: ETH在2300美元附近拉锯，反弹还缺什么？
subTitle:
BTC有ETF资金回流，ETH的资金表现却没有同步转强。这比“以太坊什么时候补涨”，更值得先看清楚。
10月29日，截至发稿，BiyaPay行情页面显示，ETH约2317美元，BTC约8万美元。价格是页面快照，不能当作全天收盘。真正值得讨论的，是同一次美联储会议之后，不同资产的承接力量并不一样。
数据显示，美国现货以太坊ETF在10月26日净流出8860万美元，27日净流出6020万美元，28日再流出2140万美元，三个交易日合计流出约1.70亿美元。同期比特币ETF则合计净流入约4.24亿美元。
这组对比不能证明所有资金都在“卖ETH、买BTC”，两类基金的规模、投资者和持仓需求不同。但它至少提醒我们：宏观环境相同，不代表每种资产都能得到相同的新增买盘。
我看ETH，会先区分价格反弹与资金回流。如果BTC上涨带动情绪，ETH也可能跟随反弹；但要形成更持续的行情，还需要自己的需求支撑。ETF连续流出意味着这一渠道的份额需求在收缩，却不能直接等同于全市场都在抛售。其他现货买盘、持仓调整和合约仓位，仍然会影响价格。
因此，单日ETF转正值得观察，连续多日改善才更有说服力。成交量很大也不等于净买入很大，频繁换手与新增资金是两回事。
第二个问题，是生态活跃能否传导到ETH本身。稳定币、交易和应用增加，可以体现网络用途，但应用产生的收益不会自动全部归给ETH持有人。还需要看活动发生在哪一层、用户承担多少费用，以及这些使用需求怎样影响ETH的消耗、持有和流通。
所以，“生态里又有一个热门项目”与“ETH的长期需求因此增加”，中间需要具体解释。只把项目热度相加，容易高估代币已经获得的价值支撑。
第三，要看ETH相对BTC是否改善。美元价格上涨，可能主要来自整个市场回暖；ETH相对BTC走强，才更能说明资金提高了对ETH的偏好。但这一比值也需要连续观察，不能因为几个小时反弹，就提前宣布资金轮动已经完成。
研究这些差异时，行情跟踪和资金安排也要衔接。BiyaPay通过一个技术入口连接数字资产、美股相关服务与币种兑换，便于比较不同市场并管理账户；可通过USDT 兑换 USD 后直接参与美股、港股交易，实现链上资金与证券市场的无缝衔接。还可以数字货币对法币，轻松地投资数字资产。
接下来，我更关注ETF流出是否缓和、ETH相对BTC是否持续改善，以及网络使用能否形成更明确的代币需求。若几项指标一起改善，反弹的依据会更充分；如果只有价格随BTC抬升，资金和需求没有跟上，判断就需要保持克制。
ETH是否值得关注，关键是它能吸引什么需求，而不是它比过去某个高点便宜多少。跌得多不自动构成低估，反弹也不自动代表趋势已经改变。

Later, the guy told me that the moment he tapped the withdrawal button, his back was covered in cold sweat. He was terrified it was all just a dream.

He said that when he had the money in his hands, his first reaction wasn’t euphoria—it was fear. He’d seen too many people make ten or twenty times their money in a market like this, then get greedy and add leverage, only to lose every last bit of their capital overnight.

So from the very beginning, he set one hard-and-fast rule for himself: as soon as the price hit his target, get out immediately. Not a trace of greed allowed.

It sounds like a legend, but only we know how many nights he stayed up over those five days, how many candlesticks he watched, and how many times he fought the urge to add to his position.

Crypto’s madness has never been about handing everyone free money. In an incredibly short time, it puts your luck, judgment, and character to the test—all at once.

The reason the guy managed to walk away with his profits intact this time was never gambler’s luck. It was the clear-headedness to hold on to his limits amid all the madness.

Now he’s continuing to trade alongside me with a fixed position of 100,000 yuan. His next withdrawal target is 500,000 yuan.

Attention, crypto newbies! #ETH 

The one thing small traders should avoid most: seeing a glimmer of hope and immediately betting everything on it

When people only have a few hundred or a few thousand USDT in starting capital, they often feel it’s too little. They think the only way to grow it quickly is to go all in, take a huge position, and try to score big in one go.

But in reality, before their money has a chance to grow, their own trading decisions often take them out of the game.
I’ve seen plenty of people make a little money from a few small market moves. Their accounts start to grow, and so does their confidence. They think they’ve found the secret to making money, then start going all in to chase hot trends—buying as prices rise and selling as they fall.

But when they get the direction wrong, a single pullback can wipe out all the profits they’ve built up—and even eat into their original capital.

The key to growing a small account isn’t betting on one big opportunity. It’s making sure you can stay in the market.

You must manage your position size. Don’t put all your chips on the table from the start. There will always be more opportunities in the market. But if one bad trade leaves you without the capital to take part in the next move, that’s the real problem.

And don’t try to catch every market move. Don’t rush in just because others are making money, and don’t blindly buy the dip when prices plunge. If you can’t read the trend, judge the timing, or calculate the risk, it’s better to miss out than to jump in recklessly.

One of the most important lessons in trading is learning to accept mistakes.
No one can guarantee that every trade will be right. Cutting your losses promptly when you’re wrong is far better than holding a bad position and fantasizing about a rebound. Many people don’t lose money because of one mistake; they lose because they refuse to admit they were wrong, and end up sinking deeper and deeper.

Once you’ve made a profit, you also need to know how to protect it. If the market is moving in your favor, you can take profits in stages. Don’t always expect to capture the entire move. There will always be more money to make in the market, but once you lose your capital, starting over can be very difficult.

It’s never about getting rich through luck. It’s about repeatedly doing the right things and letting small advantages add up over time.

Keep your capital alive first; then think about growing your returns.
The truly skilled trader isn’t someone who catches every opportunity. It’s someone who is already prepared before the opportunity comes.

小资金最忌讳的一件事：刚看到希望，就开始拿命去赌

很多人本金只有几百U、几千U的时候，总觉得自己资金太少，想快速做大就必须重仓、梭哈、抓一波大的

但现实往往是，钱还没滚起来，人先被自己的操作搞出局了
侠哥见过不少人，前面靠几次小行情赚了一点，账户开始增长，心态也跟着膨胀，觉得自己已经找到赚钱的方法，然后开始满仓追热点、追涨杀跌

结果一旦方向判断错，一次回撤就把之前积累的利润全部打回去，甚至本金都受到影响

其实小资金想做大，最重要的不是赌一次机会，而是保证自己一直有资格留在市场里

仓位一定要控制，不要一开始就把所有筹码压上。市场机会永远都有，但如果一次操作失误导致没有本金参与下一次行情，那才是真正的问题

还有就是不要什么行情都想抓，别人赚钱的时候别急着冲，看到暴跌也别盲目抄底。趋势没看清，位置没判断好，风险没计算明白，宁愿错过，也不要乱上

交易里最重要的一课，就是接受错误
没有人能保证每一单都对，错了及时止损，比拿着错误仓位幻想反弹强得多。很多人不是亏在一次失误，而是不愿承认错误，最后越套越深

赚到利润以后，也要懂得保护。行情走顺了可以分批落袋，不要总想着吃完整段走势，市场的钱永远赚不完，但本金亏掉之后，重新开始会很难

从来不是靠运气暴富，而是不断重复正确的事情，让小优势慢慢积累

先让本金活下来，再谈收益放大
真正厉害的交易者，不是每次都抓住机会，而是在机会来之前，已经做好了准备

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Positions: Fortune Favors the Bold—or an Accelerator to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Rolling positions” has been all the rage lately, and every story is the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, then roll it over a few times
and multiply your money dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【What rolling positions involves】Instead of cashing out floating profits, you treat them as risk capital for new positions and keep opening trades,
It’s like using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be incredible; when the trend stops, your floating profits can go from
up dozens of points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The mathematical truth】The essence of rolling positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the chance of getting it right four times in a row
is only 13%. Behind every post you see about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

One of the biggest misconceptions in crypto is thinking that once your account is in profit, the money already belongs to you. #ETH 

But what truly tests a person is often the final step: cashing out.

I’ve seen plenty of people with unrealized profits of tens or even hundreds of thousands in their accounts when the market is doing well. They watch the numbers keep climbing, get excited, and feel like they’ve already made the money.

But when it’s time to withdraw or transfer funds, they realize things aren’t as simple as they imagined. Some run into reviews; others have their accounts restricted because of mistakes they made. Only then do they understand that making money through trading is just the process—getting those profits back safely is the result.

Spend enough time in this market and you’ll see that making money depends on judgment and execution, while keeping it depends on the details.

First, keep your trading funds separate from your living expenses. Don’t mix all your money together. Organize your finances properly, and it’ll be much easier to review your trades or manage your funds later on.

Second, don’t choose opaque channels just to save a little on fees. Often, the real risks don’t come from the market, but from small details you’ve overlooked. Safety and stability will always matter more than a little short-term gain.

Another thing people often overlook: don’t make frequent transactions as soon as your funds arrive. Making a large transfer right away or moving money back and forth between multiple accounts can create unnecessary complications. There’s no need to rush—playing it safe matters more.

Also, make sure to keep your transaction records.
You might not think much of your transaction history, fund flows, or deposit and withdrawal records in everyday life, but if a problem arises, these are your most direct evidence.

Many people spend years gradually building up their accounts, only to end up in a difficult position because they mishandled a few details.
Truly skilled traders don’t just know how to grow their accounts; they also know how to protect their profits.

Making money is a skill. Keeping what you’ve earned is the real measure of strength.

content:
很多人在币圈最大的误区，就是以为账户盈利了，钱就已经属于自己了。#ETH 

但真正考验一个人的，往往是最后落袋的那一步。

我见过不少人，行情好的时候账户里有几万甚至几十万的浮盈，看着数字不断上涨，整个人都很兴奋，觉得自己已经赚到了。

可真正到了提现、转资金的时候，才发现事情没有想象中那么简单，有的人遇到审核，有的人因为操作不当导致账户受限，最后才明白，交易赚钱只是过程，把利润安全拿回来才是结果。

在这个市场待久了会发现，赚到钱靠的是判断和执行，但守住钱靠的是细节。

首先，交易资金和生活资金一定要分开，不要所有资金都混在一起。平时做好分类管理，后面不管是复盘交易还是处理资金都会更加清晰。

其次，不要为了省一点手续费，去选择一些不透明的渠道。很多时候，真正的风险不是来自行情，而是来自自己忽略的小细节。安全和稳定，永远比眼前的一点利益更重要。

还有一点很多人容易忽略，资金到账后不要频繁操作。刚收到资金就大额转账、多个账户来回切换，很容易给自己增加不必要的麻烦。赚钱不差这一点时间，稳一点反而更重要。

另外，交易记录一定要保存好。
每一笔交易记录、资金流水、充值提现信息，平时可能觉得没什么用，但真正遇到问题的时候，这些就是最直接的依据。

很多人花几年时间把账户一点点做起来，最后却因为一些细节处理不好，让自己陷入被动。
真正厉害的交易者，不只是懂得怎么把账户做大，更懂得怎么保护自己的利润。

赚钱是一种能力，守住赚来的钱，才是真正的实力

以太坊市场深度解析：多重利空叠加短期承压明显

2026年10月29日

一、价格走势分析

以太坊在过去二十四小时内下跌约百分之二，最新报价两千三百零七美元。价格从两千三百二十一点六四美元开盘后持续走低，最低触及两千三百零五美元附近。小时级别K线显示，以太坊已经连续多个小时运行在下降通道中，空方控盘迹象明显。

均线系统方面，当前价格跌破了七日均线两千三百一十四美元、二十五日均线两千三百四十一美元和九十九日均线两千三百三十四美元，形成了典型的空头排列。超级趋势指标显示阻力位在两千三百五十九美元，距离当前价格约有五十二美元的差距。短期来看，价格需要首先收复七日均线才能企稳。

布林带数据显示，价格已经运行在下轨两千二百九十五美元附近，中轨位于两千三百三十六美元。布林带开口持续扩大，波动率上升。如果下轨支撑失守，以太坊可能进一步下探两千两百九十美元区域。不过值得注意的是，最新一根K线出现了小幅反弹，收盘价两千三百一十四美元略高于开盘价，显示低位有一定承接力量。

二、技术指标解读

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为三十五点五四，较前一小时的二十八点七四有所回升，说明短期超卖后出现了一定的修复。十二周期RSI为三十七点七四，二十四周期RSI为四十二点六四，整体仍处于中性偏弱区间。

MACD指标呈现明显的空头格局，DIF线为负九点三八，DEA线为负五点四二，柱状图为负三点九六。虽然绿柱仍在扩大，但扩大速度从之前的五点三三收窄至三点九六，显示下跌动能有边际减弱的迹象。如果后续绿柱开始缩短，将是短期企稳的积极信号。

KDJ指标显示K值为二十八点六二，D值为二十九点三九，J值为二十七点零七。三线在低位有粘合的迹象，如果K线向上穿越D线形成金叉，将确认短期反弹信号。目前仍需等待明确的方向选择。

威廉指标读数为负七十八点七零，处于超卖区域。ATR指标为十六点零零，波动率较前期有所下降，可能预示着方向性突破即将到来。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临多重利空因素。首先是宏观层面的压力，美联储维持高利率且出现鹰派分歧，市场风险偏好下降，以太坊作为高贝塔资产首当其冲。其次，链上数据显示超过五千万美元的大额资金在过去数小时内净流出，休眠的ICO时代地址和基金会地址向中心化交易所转入大量ETH，增加了潜在的抛售压力。

从市场结构来看，以太坊相对比特币的弱势格局仍在延续。比特币年初至今跌幅约百分之七，而以太坊的表现更为疲软。投资者需要关注两千三百美元关口的支撑有效性，以及MACD绿柱能否开始收窄作为企稳信号。

subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Pyramiding: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going all-in right away and adding to your full position with floating profits is a recipe for ending up on the liquidation list.
A common mistake. The right approach is called pyramiding.

【Principle】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After the pullback is confirmed, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position; keeping your cost basis weighted toward lower prices helps you withstand pullbacks.

【Why the opposite is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more as the price rises) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses; once you lose your nerve, all your decisions go off track.

If you want to buy crypto through regulated channels in Russia, you may first have to clear a hurdle: a “unified knowledge test.”

According to remarks by Ekaterina Andreeva, first vice president of the National Association of Securities Market Participants (NAUFOR), at Crypto Summit 2026, as well as Odaily and crypto.news reports citing RBC, a draft unified testing standard for crypto investors has been completed and submitted last week to the Bank of Russia’s Basic Standards Committee. Brokers expect to start testing clients as early as late November. Results are intended to be recognized across regulated platforms, with a standardized question bank and process.

Here are a few points that really matter to ordinary people 👇

🔹 This isn’t a case of “buy whatever you want.” The test is part of the framework established by Federal Law 282-FZ (on digital currency and digital rights), which takes effect on September 1, 2026. Individuals buying or selling digital currency through licensed intermediaries will generally need to verify their identity and pass a knowledge test first. The test is free, taken electronically in written form, and designed to assess whether you understand the risks.

🔹 Both non-qualified and qualified investors must take the test, but the requirements differ. The central bank’s previously stated position is that non-qualified investors will be tested on basic risks and the characteristics of tradable assets, which will be limited to a whitelist of highly liquid assets. Qualified investors must also take a test, but the questions will focus more on complex risks. There is also a separate “qualified investor certification exam”—don’t confuse that with this “knowledge test before buying crypto.”

🔹 The limits are written into the rules. After passing the test, non-qualified investors may purchase up to 300,000 rubles’ worth of eligible crypto assets per year through each intermediary. Qualified investors who pass are not subject to this cap and have a wider range of assets they can trade. Cryptocurrency is still prohibited for domestic payments—cross-border trade is subject to separate arrangements.

🔹 The industry particularly hopes that “passing once will let you use it everywhere.” NAUFOR says it wants results to be accepted across regulated platforms, so investors won’t have to retake the test just because they switch brokers or exchanges. Exchanges, conversion services, and digital custodians will adopt the same question bank once the official basic standard is published. Under the law, a passing result is valid for one year, or may be extended from the date of the most recent relevant transaction—whichever is later.

Put simply: if you’re in Russia and plan to buy assets such as BTC or ETH through licensed channels, keep an eye on when testing begins, whether the question bank is standardized, and which cap applies to your investor category. Would you take the test for the 300,000-ruble limit, or go straight for qualified investor status? Let’s talk in the comments 👇

#俄罗斯拟推加密投资者统一测试 #BTC #ETH

content:
想在俄罗斯受监管渠道买币，可能要先过一关「统一知识测试」。

据俄罗斯证券市场参与者协会（NAUFOR）第一副总裁 Ekaterina Andreeva 在 Crypto Summit 2026 上的说明，以及 Odaily、crypto.news 等对 RBC 报道的转述：面向加密投资者的统一测试标准草案已制定完成，上周提交至俄罗斯央行基础标准委员会。券商预计最早 11 月底开始给客户做测试；通过后的成绩拟在各受监管平台互认，题库与流程也按统一口径走。

几个对普通人真正要紧的点👇

🔹 这不是「想买就买」。它挂在 2026 年 9 月 1 日生效的联邦法 282-FZ（数字货币与数字权利）框架下：经持牌中介买卖数字货币，自然人一般要先完成身份核验，再通过知识测试。测试免费、以电子书面答题形式进行，用来评估你是否理解风险

🔹 合格与非合格投资者都要测，但路径不同。央行此前口径：非合格投资者偏基础风险与可交易资产特征，且采用白名单高流动性资产；合格投资者也要测，但题目更偏复杂风险。另有一条「合格投资者认定考试」是另一套通道，别和这次「买币前知识测试」混成一件事

🔹 额度写进规则里。非合格投资者通过测试后，经每家中介每年可购买的合格加密资产上限为 30 万卢布；合格投资者通过后不适用该额度上限，可交易范围也更宽。国内支付仍禁止用加密货币结算——跨境贸易另有安排

🔹 「通过一次就能到处用」是行业预期的重点。NAUFOR 称希望成绩在受监管平台间通用，避免换一家券商/交易所就重考；正式基础标准公布后，交易所、兑换机构、数字托管等才会按同一套题库落地。通过结果的有效期按法律为一年，或自最近一次相关交易日起延展（以后到者为准）

说白了：若你人在俄罗斯、准备走持牌渠道买 BTC/ETH 一类资产，接下来要盯的是「何时开测、题库是否统一、你的投资者类别对应哪档额度」。你会为了那 30 万卢布额度去过测，还是直接走合格投资者路径？评论区聊聊👇

That night, my 200,000 yuan investment was wiped out in a single night!! #ETH 

That evening, Ying stared at his account for a long time. There was only one thought in his mind: “I’ve really gone too far this time.”

When I first got into crypto 8 years ago, I was like a lot of people: chasing pumps, going all in, and holding losing positions. Whenever I lost money, I thought I could make it back on the next trade. It wasn’t until I lost that 200,000 yuan that I truly began to change the way I traded.

Over the years, I reviewed my losses from the past 7 years and gradually came up with 9 rules that I still follow today.

1. Don’t rush to double a small account
The smaller your starting capital, the less you should go all in. First, keep each loss under control. You have to survive before you can benefit from compounding.

2. Watch out for selling the news
When major positive news breaks, don’t assume the price will keep rising. If the price surges but volume and price action start to weaken, I prioritize taking profits.

3. Manage risk ahead of major news
Before important data releases, policy announcements, or holidays, if I can’t read the direction, I’d rather reduce my position or even stay out of the market until the trend becomes clear.

4. Keep positions small for medium- and long-term trades
The longer you hold, the more variables you’ll face, so don’t commit too much of your capital.

5. For short-term trades, follow the trend
I used to like guessing where the bottom was, but the price often kept falling right after I bought. Now I only trade established trends, and consider entering after a pullback stabilizes.

6. Watch for sharp pullbacks after rapid rallies
The faster the price rises, the bigger the swings tend to be. In this kind of market, I won’t chase just because I’m afraid of missing out.

7. Cut your losses as soon as you’re wrong
I used to hold on when I was down 5%, then add to my position at a 10% loss. In the end, a small loss turned into a big one. Now I decide where I’ll exit before I enter a trade.

8. Use 15-minute candlestick charts for short-term trades
I use the 15-minute timeframe to observe short-term market structure, then confirm with other indicators instead of making buy or sell decisions based on a single candle.

9. In the end, it all comes down to mindset
After losing 200,000 yuan in a single day, the biggest change for me was that I stopped thinking I had to make it back immediately.

If there’s no opportunity in the market, wait. If you get it wrong, get out.

There will always be another market opportunity. What really matters is whether you still have capital left to take advantage of it.

那天晚上盈哥盯着账户很久，脑子里只有一个念头：这次真的玩大了
​
8年前刚进币圈，我也跟很多人一样，追涨、重仓、扛单，亏了就想着下一单赚回来。那次20万归零之后，我才开始真正改变自己的交易方式

后来我把这7年一次次亏损复盘下来，慢慢总结出9条自己一直在用的规则

1. 小资金别急着翻倍
本金越小，越不能重仓梭哈。先把每一笔亏损控制住，活下来才有后面的复利

2. 利好兑现要防出货
重大利好落地后，不要只想着继续涨。价格冲高但量价开始转弱，我会优先考虑落袋。

3. 重大消息提前防风险
重要数据、政策、节假日前，如果看不懂方向，我宁愿减仓甚至空仓，等行情走出来再做

4. 中长线一定轻仓
拿得越久，遇到的变量越多，所以仓位不能压太满

5. 短线只做顺势
以前我喜欢猜底，结果经常刚买进去继续跌。现在只做已经走出来的趋势，回踩企稳再考虑进

6. 快涨之后防快速回撤
涨得越急，波动往往也越大。遇到这种行情，我不会因为害怕踏空就追进去

7. 错了直接止损
以前亏5%不走，亏10%开始补，最后一笔小亏扛成大亏。现在进场前就确定好自己的退出位置

8. 短线结合15分钟K线
我会用15分钟级别观察短线结构，再结合其他指标确认，而不是只凭一根K线决定买卖

9. 最后拼的是心态
20万一天归零以后，我最大的改变就是不再想着必须马上赚回来

行情没机会就等，做错了就走

行情永远有下一次，真正重要的是你还有没有本金等下一次

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 USDT in capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 USDT on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down just 20%, a few good trades can get you back. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—the math has basically already sentenced you to failure.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%.” It’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
is no more than 2%.” So the right order is: find your stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scaled profit-taking strategy I always use.

【Three stages】Stage one: when the price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), sell a third to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset changes instantly. Stage two: when the price reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), sell another third. Stage three: use a trailing stop for the rest; exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run. 【Why this works】Sell everything too early and you'll kick yourself; hold everything and you'll often ride the elevator all the way back to breakeven.

The secret to turning 30,000 into 300,000 trading crypto: the nuclear position-compounding formula #ETH 

Ying has traded crypto for over 10 years. He lost money throughout his first three years, but over the following seven years—and up to today—he has achieved steady compounding.

The key to the 10x position-compounding rule: big profits come from trends, not frequent trading.

Most people fail not because they lack trading skills, but because they have no trading system.

First, choosing the right coins matters more than knowing how to trade. Only trade strong coins, popular coins, and coins in an uptrend. Avoid weak rebounds, and don't try to catch falling knives in a downtrend.

Second, add to winners and cut losses. Keep your initial position within a reasonable size. Add to it only when the market moves in your favor; exit immediately when it moves against you. Never add to a losing position.

Third, let your profits run. Accept small losses quickly, and have the patience to hold on to big winners.

A single trending move can often cover the cost of multiple failed attempts.

Fourth, risk management can make or break you. Control your position size, keep cash on hand, and use strict stop-losses.

There will always be opportunities in the market, but you only get one shot with your capital.

Fifth, waiting is the greatest skill. There aren't many truly big opportunities in a year. Spend most of your time waiting, then strike with a large position when the time is right.

Remember this: test the waters with small positions and follow the trend with large ones; accept small losses and hold on to big gains. True compounding doesn't come from trading every day—it comes from catching a few key trends.

translatedData.content:
Google has locked up its own assets on ETH and SOL in a new vault it built itself.

The product is called Google Multi-Party Compute. It’s still in private testing and won’t be commercially available until early 2027. They haven’t said a word about pricing.

What it does is simple: the private key never exists in its entirety in one place.
A bank can keep one share in Google Cloud, one in its own data center, and one in another cloud provider’s environment.
You set the signing threshold yourself: transactions can only be signed when 2 of 3 shares, or 5 of 7 shares, are brought together.

There’s another checkpoint before signing:
Transfer limits, sending only to whitelisted addresses, requiring approval from several departments—all these rules run in an isolated hardware environment. Google says it can’t see the plaintext key either.
At the inaugural digital assets symposium in New York, the people onstage were from Morgan Stanley, Citi, and Wells Fargo.

My take:
This isn’t for retail investors. It’s a stepping stone for the big institutions that still don’t dare touch on-chain assets.
Thefts involving private keys have already reached the tens-of-billions-of-dollars range, and the root cause is often a single key or a compromised machine.
Google isn’t selling a new technological idea—MPC has been around for a while. It’s selling a brand that compliance departments feel comfortable signing off on.
The ones really being squeezed are independent custodians in the middle.
Banks used to have to hire specialized custodians. In the future, they may just tick another box on their cloud bill.

This is a slow-moving factor for crypto prices, not a catalyst for today.
$ETH  is about 2,314; $SOL  is about 100. The market is falling along with the broader market.
But the path for institutions to enter is getting wider and wider. That’s more worth remembering than a single candlestick.

Security failure at Indian certificate firm bites Ethereum as developers rush out fixes

A cryptography slip at an Indian certificate company has made its way into Ethereum, where it could have let attackers quietly send some validators’ block rewards to themselves.

Teku, the software many validators use to run Ethereum’s proof-of-stake side, released version 26.10.3 on Tuesday. Besu, which processes Ethereum transactions, released version 26.10.2 on Monday. Both updates stop trusting certificates tied to eMudhra, an Indian certificate authority, in their Docker images, the prepackaged versions many operators run.

Validators are the computers that stake ETH to secure Ethereum and earn fees for proposing blocks. Some of them talk to other services over the internet, and they rely on digital certificates to make sure they’re talking to the right one.

What broke
On Oct. 17, researchers found that the private keys behind eight of eMudhra’s intermediate certificate authorities had been generated with too little randomness.

That meant the keys could be worked out from the certificates themselves, which are public. Anyone holding those keys could issue certificates that unpatched software would accept as real. Browsers blocked the certificates, eMudhra revoked them a day later, and the company has since said it will exit the certificate business.#Write2Earn $ETH

title: Bitcoin ETFs Recover, Ether ETFs Bleed: The $1.32B Split Behind ETH at $2,350
subTitle:
📉Ether ETF outflows keep stacking while Bitcoin funds return to inflows. Here's what the data shows, what could change it, and what to watch.

Same Fed, same market, two very different answers. Bitcoin ETFs are getting money back, and Ether ETFs are still losing it. 🤔
📊 What Happened?
On Monday, October 26, US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $110.3M, entirely through BlackRock's IBIT, while spot Ether ETFs lost $88.6M.
October's Ether ETF outflow is now about $1.32 billion, and it was already the biggest monthly outflow of 2026 by October 21.
Last week showed the same split. Bitcoin funds netted $301M despite a $635.6M Thursday exit, while Ether ETFs lost $221M after about $320M the week before.
📉 Where ETH Is
ETH sits near $2,350 after the Fed held rates at 3.75%–4.00%, up about 1% on the day. It started the month near $2,700, so it's roughly 13% lower since.
The bigger warning is in the US the Coinbase Premium Index hit its lowest level since February, which points to soft US buying.
📐 The Divergence Traders Are Watching
Even the "good" side is narrow. IBIT drew $565.7M last week while the other Bitcoin funds lost about $264.5M.
On the Other side, BlackRock's ETHA lost $104.7M on Monday while Fidelity's FETH added $16.13M. Flows are not just weak, they are concentrated in a few funds.
🔄 What Changed in the Flows
Ether ETFs were still strong in September, with $832M of inflows. Daily outflows began on September 29 and accelerated in October.
When steady ETF buying turns into steady selling, spot buyers have to absorb the difference. That is what $2,350 is testing.
🧱 The Other Side of the Story
One bad month is not a collapse. Ether ETFs were still net positive by about $610M in 2026 as of October 18, and ETH gained 71% in Q3. Flows measure investor activity, not future price.
⚠️ The Risk Scenario
ETH was down nearly 18% for 2026 as of October 21, and elevated bond yields and talk of a December rate hike limit risk appetite. CoinGape flags $2,278 as a key support level. A close below it would give bears the weak-demand story they want.
If outflows slow and the Coinbase Premium recovers, the setup changes. Neither outcome is certain.
👀 Three Things to Watch Next
Do Ether ETFs post several inflow days in a row?Does the Coinbase Premium recover from its lowest level since February?Do Bitcoin ETF inflows spread beyond IBIT?
💡 The key takeaway
Bitcoin ETFs are recovering while Ether ETFs lose money at the fastest pace of 2026. ETH sits above $2,278 support, but the US demand signals are weak.
The real question isn't whether ETH holds $2,350 today. It's whether ETF buyers return before support breaks.

That is the part worth watching.

以太坊ETH市场深度分析：鲸鱼抛压与机构买盘的博弈

一、价格走势分析

北京时间2026年10月29日，以太坊报价2328美元，过去24小时下跌约1.2%。从小时K线来看，ETH在亚盘时段呈现窄幅震荡走势。凌晨开盘价2314美元，盘中最高触及2335美元，最低下探至2293美元，整体波动幅度约42美元，显示市场处于方向选择的关键节点。

以太坊近期的下跌主要受到鲸鱼转账行为的直接影响。链上监测数据显示，休眠的ICO早期参与者向中心化交易所转入超过2119枚ETH，触发了超过5000万美元的净小时流出，价格一度快速下探至2309美元。这种大户抛压对短期价格形成了明显的压制作用。与此同时，美联储维持利率不变的鹰派决议也进一步打压了市场的风险偏好。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，ETH当前价格已全面跌破主要均线。7周期均线位于2321美元，25周期均线位于2345美元，99周期均线位于2336美元，价格运行在所有均线下方，短期空头排列格局确立。指数移动平均线同样呈现空头信号，7周期EMA为2324美元，25周期EMA为2338美元，99周期EMA为2345美元，均线系统对价格形成层层压制。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于2379美元，中轨位于2340美元，下轨位于2301美元。当前价格运行在中轨与下轨之间，接近下轨区域，短期存在超卖反弹的技术条件。MACD指标持续走弱，DIF线为负7.92，DEA线为负3.29，柱状图为负4.63，空头动能仍在延续。RSI方面，6周期RSI为31.2，12周期RSI为36.2，24周期RSI为42.1，短周期已进入超卖区域。KDJ指标中K值为29.3，D值为30.9，J值为26.0，三线在低位纠缠，等待方向选择。

从信号因子来看，15个因子中7个看多、7个看空、1个中性，多空力量基本均衡。但复合指标仍发出看空信号，历史胜率为65.96%，说明在当前形态下空头略占优势。威廉指标显示当前读数为负79.1，处于超卖区域，暗示短期存在反弹需求。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临鲸鱼抛压与机构买盘的双重博弈。一方面，早期ICO持有者和基金会关联钱包持续向交易所转移供应，对现货市场形成持续的卖压威胁。另一方面，机构资金仍在逢低吸纳。富达近期买入价值1880万美元的ETH，巴西银行巨头Itau Unibanco也扩展了加密托管业务，这些机构行为为价格提供了一定的下方支撑。

从宏观环境来看，美联储的鹰派立场叠加稳定币借贷利率上升，限制了杠杆资金的扩张空间，对ETH的短期反弹构成制约。不过，以太坊在2300美元附近表现出较强的买盘承接力，显示市场对该价位的认可度较高。综合来看，ETH短期偏弱震荡，但2300美元一线支撑较为坚实，投资者需密切关注鲸鱼转账动态和美联储后续政策信号。

translatedData.title: Where exactly should you place your stop-loss? Here’s how I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Place it too close and it gets triggered every day; place it too far away and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-percentage method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners.
It helps you build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop may end up right in a cluster of other traders’ stop-losses.

【Technical-level stop-loss method】Place it where the structure becomes invalid: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, it’s evidence that I was wrong.
Adjust your position size accordingly: the farther away the stop-loss is, the smaller your position should be, so that the loss on any one trade remains a portion of your capital.

US 10-year Treasury yield hits 5.05% | ETH rebound still lacks fund-flow confirmation | Stay disciplined around 2320

My stance is cautious. For now, I’m not treating ETH’s rebound from around $2,300 as a trend reversal. In the US Treasury’s daily Treasury par yield curve rates table published on October 28, the 10-year yield was 5.05%, up from 4.99% on October 27. That same day, the Federal Reserve’s official statement kept the target range for the federal funds rate at 3.75% to 4%. Binance OTC’s official account also noted this week that longer-term yields were rising and risk assets were under pressure. But that was a trading desk’s market interpretation, not a central bank guarantee about ETH’s direction. The Treasury table and Fed statement are verifiable facts; whether ETH will keep falling is still a matter of judgment.

Why pay attention to longer-term yields? Crypto assets don’t pay fixed coupons. When risk-free yields rise, the opportunity cost of holding volatile assets can increase, especially when the market hasn’t seen sustained new buying. Funds may initially favor BTC, which has deeper liquidity. This relationship isn’t mechanical: rising yields may also coincide with other growth expectations, so ETH can’t be forecast based on a single number. The Binance Square trending list and Most Searched currently have no trending tags that precisely match ETH and the 10-year yield, so I won’t bring in unrelated stock earnings topics. The project’s official blog still lists the Hoodi testnet upgrade date as TBD, so I won’t present a tentative schedule as an upgrade to mainnet that has already happened.

Fund flows provide another piece of the puzzle. In the latest complete data listed by Farside, US spot ETH funds saw total net outflows of $21.4 million on October 28, including $44.8 million in outflows from ETHA and $18.8 million in inflows to FETH. On the same day, BTC funds saw total net inflows of $137.3 million. The different directions of these fund flows show why we can’t generalize that “institutions are buying crypto” to mean every coin is seeing simultaneous net inflows. Fund data is from the previous trading day, doesn’t represent all spot trading, and doesn’t prove that interest-rate changes directly caused fund redemptions. What’s more worth watching is whether flows continue to change over the next two or three trading days.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,321, below the day’s open of $2,357, with an intraday low of around $2,291. Ethereum Researchers Explore Transaction Assertions to Reduce Signing Risks

TL;DR: Ethereum Foundation researchers are examining native transaction assertions that could make transaction safety depend on the final state as well as the signed instructions. The official source also identifies specific limits or future steps, so implementation and market impact should not be assumed.

Ethereum Foundation researchers are examining native transaction assertions that could make transaction safety depend on the final state as well as the signed instructions. For digital-asset markets, the important issue is less the announcement in isolation than the channel through which it could affect users, capital or network activity. The latest development deserves attention, but its relevance depends on the facts published by the organisation behind it and the work still required to make it matter.

What the primary announcement establishes
The foundation describes blind signing and uncertain execution outcomes as distinct ways users can approve actions with unwanted results. The research explores checks that inspect net balance, storage or code changes after execution and revert the transaction if a required rule fails.

EIP-7906 is a possible route, using a read-only post-transaction frame to evaluate changes and events before accepting the outcome. The foundation states that EIP-7906 is under consideration, not yet confirmed for a future upgrade, and would still require wallets or protocols to enforce a rule.

Why this could matter for crypto markets
A transaction signature proves authorisation of certain bytes; it does not by itself guarantee that a complex smart-contract interaction achieves the signer’s economic objective. Independent checks over final balances or approvals could narrow that gap. Yet they introduce design choices about who defines the rule, how much gas it costs and whether third-party software can silently omit it.#Write2Earn $ETH

translatedData.content:
My assessment is that the risk in this Ethereum client patch lies not in on-chain consensus, but in the TLS certificate trust chain relied on by node operators. Whether this assessment holds depends on whether the affected nodes are primarily those with non-default configurations, and whether certificate trust stores are updated promptly.

According to CoinDesk, Indian certificate authority eMudhra made an error in issuing certificates, causing some Teku and Besu deployments to trust forged certificates; the report also says that default mainnet nodes were not exposed. It is important to distinguish facts from inference: the certificate issuance error and the affected clients are facts reported by the source; the claim that “an attacker could use forged certificates to redirect the ETH rewards path” is a potential risk inferred from those facts. This summary provides no evidence that an attack has actually occurred.

Mechanically, node software relies on the system’s or its own built-in certificate trust store for external communications. If the trust store includes a certificate that should not be trusted, a man-in-the-middle could impersonate the other party and direct the node to an incorrect service address. For staking nodes, this could affect whether the configuration of the rewards payout path can be tampered with. The fact that default mainnet configurations were not exposed suggests that most nodes deployed through standard procedures are currently safe, but operators using custom certificates, private networks, or special proxy settings should check their configurations themselves.

In my view, what is truly worth monitoring in events like this is not the market’s price reaction, but three things: whether the affected versions and patch notes are clearly specified; what proportion of all nodes use non-default configurations; and the progress of revoking eMudhra-related certificates and updating trust stores. If later disclosures show that default configurations were also affected, or that the patch did not cover all cases, the assessment above—that the exposure is limited—will need to be revised.

content:
我的判断是：这次以太坊客户端修补的风险点不在链上共识，而在节点运营者所依赖的TLS证书信任链。这个判断能否成立，取决于受影响的是否主要是非默认配置节点，以及证书信任库的更新是否到位。

据CoinDesk报道，印度证书机构eMudhra出现证书签发失误，导致部分Teku和Besu的部署会信任伪造证书；报道同时称，默认主网节点并未暴露。这里要区分事实与推论：证书签发失误和受影响客户端是报道提供的事实；“攻击者可借伪造证书重定向ETH奖励路径”属于据此推断的潜在风险，本次摘要并未给出攻击已经发生的证据。

机制上，节点软件在对外通信时依赖系统或内置的证书信任库。一旦信任库收录了不该被信任的证书，中间人就可以冒充对端，把节点引向错误的服务地址。对质押节点而言，这关系到奖励发放路径的配置能否被篡改。默认主网配置没有暴露，说明多数按标准流程部署的节点暂时安全，但自定义证书、私有网络或特殊代理设置的运营者需要自行核对。

我的观察是，这类事件真正值得跟踪的不是币价反应，而是三件事：受影响版本与补丁说明是否明确、非默认配置节点在整体中占多大比例、eMudhra相关证书的吊销与信任库更新进度。若后续披露显示默认配置同样受影响，或补丁覆盖不全，上述“暴露面有限”的判断就需要修正。

【ETH is gaining slowly—so why is it even more worth watching?】

When AI takes over the management of funds, what’s most lacking isn’t computing power, but a verifiable settlement layer. ETH fell nearly 5% over the week and edged down slightly in a single day, while trading volume remained active. But I’m more focused on AI agents.

The CFTC chairman suggested that, in the future, even refrigerators might be able to stake ETH and issue meme coins autonomously. Google previewed a crypto custody security system that several financial institutions are testing, and Alphabet is using it to protect its own assets on Ethereum and Solana. Once machines can act autonomously, identity, custody, auditing, and accountability all become essential. That’s where the value of on-chain settlement lies.

In practical terms, the impact won’t be on crypto speculators, but on financial IT, custody security, auditing, and automated execution providers. Banks, asset managers, and exchanges will all need to change their processes. The business logic also makes sense: fintech used to help “people operate”; now it needs to serve “machines operating.”

Looking at China’s economy, policy is focused on stabilizing growth and fostering new quality productive forces. In A-shares, I’m more bullish on financial technology, cybersecurity, industrial software, and computing power and electricity—areas that can benefit from digitalization—rather than companies simply riding the AI hype. Web3 stands to benefit from institutional demand for on-chain settlement, though its development path in China remains subject to compliance constraints.

ETH may not enter a major rally right away, but AI is pushing blockchain toward becoming the settlement layer for machine finance. Do you think it can really gain traction with large institutions, or is it just another polished story?

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is a payment between longs and shorts
The two sides pay each other; the exchange merely collects and distributes the money—it doesn’t profit from it.

【Mechanism】Perpetual contracts have no settlement date, so how is the price kept in line with the spot price? That’s what the funding rate is for:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment prevails) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money changes hands between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

In the recent volatility of the $ETH  perpetual contract, a short position of $6.53 million was forcibly liquidated at a price around 2333.82.

Let's break down this liquidation data.

The forced liquidation of a large number of long positions increases selling pressure, while the forced liquidation of a large number of short positions creates additional buying pressure. This is the source of a chain reaction of forced liquidations that amplifies market movements.

The commonly used term "long squeeze" refers to a price drop triggering the liquidation of long positions, which in turn pushes down the price; "short squeeze" refers to a price rise forcing the liquidation of short positions, which in turn raises the price again.

Learning to read indicators isn't difficult; the challenge lies in executing the plan even when market conditions are extreme.

subTitle:
【一句话定调】

亚盘上午的反弹只维持了四个小时。

十币里九币 4h 翻红，唯一例外是 TON（-0.99%）；可把窗口拉到 12h，只有 BNB 和 LINK 还站在零轴上方；再看 24h，八跌二涨。三个时间维度给出的答案互相打架，而以量能看，没有一个币的成交量超过 7 日均量的七成。这是空头暂停，不是多头进场。（快照时间：北京时间 13:11）

【大盘：$BTC】

80380，24h -0.73%，4h +0.46%，12h -0.58%。

24h 区间 79710–81823，低点距布林下轨 79621 只差 89 美元——上午这一脚把下轨当支撑试了一次，没破。上方第一道是 MA7 80716，第二道 MA25 82218，现价距 MA25 还有 -2.24%。

RSI 43.6，中性偏弱；MACD 柱 -225.6，仍在零轴下方。30 日区间分位 14.5%，30 日低 79220，距 30 日高 87220 有 -7.84%。ATR 2.23%，是十币里最低的，波动正在收敛。

日内多空线很清楚：4h 收盘站上 80716，上午的低点才算被确认为短期底；失守 79710，下轨就是被有效跌破，下一道看 79220。

【二线梯队：ETH SOL XRP】

$ETH 2329.47，-1.09%，4h +0.66%。关键不在涨跌，在 MA99 2339.88——价格已落到其下方约 10 美元，这是本轮第一次实质性失守长期均线。24h 低 2293.44 与布林下轨 2293.07 几乎完全重合（差 0.37 美元），下轨被精确测试。RSI 36.1，30 日分位 9.5%。要修复，第一步收复 2339.88，第二步才是 MA7 2348.62。

SOL 100.53，-1.45%，4h +0.66%。布林位置 14.7%，30 日分位 7.6%，30 日低 98.62 就在下方 -1.9%。100 是心理位，站不稳就是 98.62，中间没有结构。

XRP 1.3015，-2.08%，4h +0.24%，是二线里最弱的反弹。MA99 1.3023 与现价几乎重合，正卡在长期均线上。MACD 柱 +0.0021 已翻红但仍在零轴下——这是下跌动能衰减的第一信号，不是反转信号。布林位置 29.6%，在弱势组里算偏高的。

【平台与支付：$BNB TON】

BNB 758.24，+1.6%，4h +1.67%。十币里三个"唯一"都在它身上：唯一 MA7（746.31）在 MA25（743.78）之上，唯一 MACD 柱在零轴上（+2.91），唯一 30 日分位过半（50.3%）。

但布林位置 92.7%，上轨 761.57 就在头顶 -0.4%，24h 高 762.20 已经摸到上轨外侧。贴上轨是强势特征，也意味着短线追高的容错极小。RSI 56.8，全组最高。

TON 1.60，24h +0.95%，但 4h -0.99%，是唯一 4h 收绿的——上午这波反弹没有它的份。更麻烦的是量能，对 7 日均量只有 0.05，几乎没人交易，价格信号的可信度很低。MA25 1.646 在上方 -2.79%，布林位置 33.2%。

【高弹性尾部：DOGE ADA AVAX LINK】

DOGE 0.07882，-1.05%，4h +0.95%。RSI 40.3，布林位置 32.3%，但量能仅 0.17，30 日分位 17.3%，反弹缺成交配合。

ADA 0.2004，-2.95% 全组最差，4h +1.16% 全组最好——跌得最狠也弹得最快，标准的高 beta 表现。但量能 0.69 全组最高，跌的时候放量，这不是好组合。30 日分位 5.5% 全组最低，24h 低 0.1956 就是 30 日低，已经躺在区间地板上；距 MA25 -11.92%，全组最远。

AVAX 8.755，-2.82%，4h +0.69%。RSI 34.7，30 日分位 6.2%，24h 低 8.559 同样等于 30 日低。ATR 5.28%，止损空间天然就宽。

LINK 11.573，-1.43%，12h +0.21%，是除 BNB 外唯一 12h 收正的。布林位置 22.0%，30 日低 11.20 在下方 -3.2%，尾部里结构相对干净的一个。

【盘面主线】

第一，时间维度错配。4h 九红、12h 二红、24h 二红，反弹只在最短的窗口里成立。亚盘上午做的是一段下跌中继的横向修复，不是趋势翻转。

第二，量能是唯一没说谎的指标。0.05–0.69，无一币过七成；ADA 量能最高却跌得最多，说明卖压在出，不是在吸。

第三，结构明显分层。BNB 单独站在 30 日区间上半部并贴布林上轨；其余九币全部落在区间下三分之一，ADA、AVAX、SOL、ETH 集中在 5.5%–9.5%。

第四，均线成了新的多空分界。九币 MA7 低于 MA25；ETH 失守 MA99，XRP 卡在 MA99，长期均线由支撑转为压制。

【操作参考】

看多需要两个条件同时成立：BTC 4h 收盘站上 80716，且成交量回到 7 日均量 0.8 以上；二线需要 ETH 先收复 2339.88。缺一个，反弹都只是区间内的一次折返。

看空的条件更简单：BTC 失守 79710；或 BNB 跌回 746.31 下方，这轮唯一的独立强势就此结束。

区间思路：BTC 79710–81823，SOL 98.62–103.85，ADA 0.1956–0.2101，LINK 11.20–12.28。

尾部四币已贴区间地板，做多是接刀、做空是追空，两边都不占优；等 4h 站上各自 MA7（ADA 0.2061、AVAX 8.9547）再谈右侧。

【风险提示】

以上为 13:11 快照数据，盘中会变。量能极低时（TON 0.05）单笔委托就能打穿关键位，看到的破位未必有效。ATR 5% 以上的尾部币，常规止损位容易被扫。欧盘开盘后常有方向选择，亚盘这段窄区间不宜提前押方向。本文只做盘面记录与条件梳理，不构成任何投资建议。

Your fridge could one day stake Ether, launch memecoins: CFTC chair

Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chair Michael Selig says it is “no longer science fiction” to imagine one’s refrigerator autonomously purchasing groceries with money earned from staking Ether — or even launching its own memecoin, raising questions about how regulators should oversee autonomous AI agents.

The colorful comment came during Selig’s remarks at the CFTC’s inaugural Frontier Forum in Washington, DC, on Wednesday, where he argued that regulators must adapt to a financial system where AI agents can hold assets and execute trades autonomously.

“We’re gathered here today to discuss a technology that’s rapidly transforming the financial markets. President Trump calls it ‘super intelligence,’ or SI, because ‘it’s not artificial.’ It’s as real as the printing press, the steam engine, and the internet,” he said.
Selig says the CFTC’s regulatory framework was developed around “identifiable market participants” performing specific financial functions, but autonomous software is raising questions about how those rules apply.

“Consider an SI agent that identifies trading opportunities and executes transactions on behalf of a user,” said Selig.

“Does the developer of that agent become subject to registration? Who is liable if the agent goes rogue? How can regulators know who the agent, or suite of agents, is trading on behalf of? Do we need a new flavor of know-your-customer, maybe KYA or know-your-agent?”

AI could democratize trading, but bring new risks
Selig said AI could give smaller traders and businesses access to risk-management that was once reserved for larger institutions.

“SI can help process the vast amount of information significantly faster than human brain power and with greater accuracy,” he said.

But greater autonomy also comes with new risks. Agents could react unexpectedly to market conditions, while those using similar models could generate correlated trading behavior. #Write2Earn #Ethereum $ETH

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, 10x leverage means 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of the position first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

Looking at the moving averages, the 7-period average is approximately $2,341, the 25-period average is approximately $2,337, and the 99-period average is approximately $2,335. For the Bollinger Bands, the upper band is approximately $2,364, the middle band approximately $2,330, and the lower band approximately $2,296. The MACD indicator shows the fast line at approximately 0.07, the slow line at approximately -2.33, and the histogram at approximately 2.40. Although the MACD lines have crossed above the zero line, the histogram continues to shrink, indicating that upward momentum is weakening. The 6-period RSI has quickly fallen from the overbought region at 82.9 to around 42, entering relatively weak territory and leaving room for further short-term correction. In the KDJ indicator, the K line has fallen to 48, the D line is at 60, and the J line has dropped to 26. Overall, Ethereum’s composite indicators are also bearish: of 15 factors, nine are bullish, five bearish, and one neutral. 一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至北京时间十月三十日凌晨，以太坊报价约两千三百五十一美元，过去二十四小时涨幅约百分之零点三五。从小时级别K线来看，价格在触及两千三百七十九美元的高点后逐步回落，最低下探至两千三百二十五美元附近，呈现冲高回落的震荡走势。以太坊近期在两千三百美元至两千三百八十美元区间内反复震荡，多空力量相对均衡。

从成交量来看，最近五个一小时的成交额分别为四千万、四千五百万、三千二百万、两千六百万和三千万美元，整体呈现先放量后缩量的特征。前期放量上攻未能有效突破两千三百八十美元阻力位，随后缩量回调显示多头信心有所动摇，短期内需要关注两千三百美元整数关口的支撑力度。

二、技术指标解读

从均线系统来看，七周期均线约为两千三百四十一美元，二十五周期均线约为两千三百三十七美元，九十九周期均线约为两千三百三十五美元，三条均线高度粘合且略微向上发散，呈现弱势多头排列。价格目前在七周期均线附近运行，短期需要关注两千三百三十五美元的九十九周期均线支撑。

布林带方面，上轨约两千三百六十四美元，中轨约两千三百三十美元，下轨约两千二百九十六美元。价格从上轨附近回落后目前在中轨上方运行，布林带开口收窄，暗示短期波动率下降，可能酝酿方向性突破。

MACD指标显示，快线约为零点零七，慢线约为负二点三三，柱状图约为二点四零，虽然MACD快慢线已经上穿零轴但柱状图持续缩小，上涨动能正在减弱。RSI六周期指标从八十二点九的超买区域快速回落至四十二附近，已进入偏弱区域，短期存在进一步回调风险。KDJ指标中K线降至四十八，D线位于六十，J线降至二十六，三线向下发散形成死叉，短期看空信号明确。

综合来看，以太坊的复合指标信号同样为看跌，十五个因子中有九个看多、五个看空、一个中性。值得注意的是，近期有休眠的创世区块和ICO时代的巨鲸钱包向中心化交易所转入超过两千一百一十八枚以太坊，增加了现货市场的抛压风险。

三、市场情绪分析

当前以太坊市场情绪呈现中性偏谨慎的格局。从利好因素来看，美联储维持基准利率在百分之四点零不变，宏观政策的稳定性为加密市场提供了一定的风险偏好支撑。以太坊生态在稳定币发行和平台支付集成方面持续扩展，提升了以太坊网络的实用价值和长期需求预期。近期尾盘出现约五十一百万美元的净流入，大单参与比例超过百分之五十，显示有资金在低位积极承接。

从风险因素来看，以太坊ETF在十月二十八日录得两千一百四十一万美元的净流出，显示机构资金需求仍存在逆风。同时，巨鲸向交易所转入大量以太坊的行为增加了短期抛压预期。技术面上，RSI从超买区域快速回落，短期可能需要通过震荡整理来消化前期涨幅。

综合判断，以太坊短期在两千三百美元至两千三百八十美元区间震荡，上方阻力关注两千三百七十美元的布林带上轨附近，下方支撑关注两千三百美元的整数关口和两千二百九十六美元的布林带下轨。建议投资者耐心等待方向明确后再做决策，注意控制仓位风险。

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。
